package_info.why_malicious: No specific malicious software package, code, or technical indicator is described in this report. The article is a high-level discussion of ransomware negotiation practices and the business structure of ransomware groups, not an analysis of a particular malware package or technical attack method.

detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: This article does not provide technical details, code samples, or indicators of compromise related to ransomware or other malware. It focuses exclusively on the negotiation process and organizational structure of ransomware groups, and does not offer actionable detection strategies or technical artifacts for automated detection systems.
